top_signals.title: Starbucks CEO Is Focused on Growth Plan, Fundamentals
top_signals.summary: Starbucks Corp. Chief Executive Officer Brian Niccol expects earnings growth to continue and he says the turnaround plan is ahead of schedule. He says becoming a multi-brand company is a possibility. The chain recently said it was not exploring a takeover of Chipotle. He speaks to Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)
